digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows and main branch continuous integration
propositions: Main branch CI workflows are cancelled when commits land in quick succession, rendering healthy commits as red X on GitHub mirror despite passing Gerrit pre-merge verification
Scheduled health checks every 6 hours on main replace push-triggered per-commit CI to eliminate cancellations while maintaining the safety net without per-commit attribution cost
A new main-health-report job resolves the last successful run SHA from Actions API and publishes a copy-pasteable git bisect recipe to failed runs for efficient remediation

Push triggers on main are removed from test.yml, optionality.yml, verify-identity.yml, prompt-eval.yml, codeql.yml, and terraform-drift.yml while preserving non-main branch push CI and all untouchable workflows
The Verified pre-merge gate remains unchanged; only the post-merge mirror safety-net cadence is altered from per-commit to periodic schedule
On-demand dispatch capability is added or preserved on every main-health workflow so operators can check main health without waiting for the scheduled tick
